blocks.x: Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy — ideal ground for governed automation. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in underwriting evidence assembly, policy servicing transactions, claims/beneficiary processing, with actuarial valuation data prep close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
Named from the floor, not from a framework — Life & Annuities edition:

items: APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Valuation and experience studies assemble from extracts with manual reconciliation; regime changes (IFRS 17) expose the debt.
Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.
Underwriting health data and beneficiary PII create long-retention sensitive estates; PQ exposure deep.
Policy admin systems resist product change; new products take quarters.
Lapse and mortality experience signals arrive late; retention and repricing actions lag.

blocks.x: Capability in Life & Annuities is not abstract: each tower lands as a named build on a named workflow. The patterns below are what we deploy there.

items: APS/paramedical/financial docs classified, extracted and assembled
valuation and experience pipelines with lineage for IFRS 17
strangler decomposition of policy admin wrappers
payment and engagement signals predicting lapse with action policy

blocks.x: Ifrs 17 / ldti — actuarial data and reporting discipline. Programs here are designed against these duties from the first sprint; evidence is a by-product of running the system, not an audit-season project.

blocks.x: For Life & Annuities, the first move costs little: a two-week diagnostic on underwriting evidence assembly, your data, one honest baseline. The scoped proposal only follows if the measured delta justifies it.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: operations in Life & Annuities, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
